texts.拉兹沃扎耶夫要求加固重要码头与泊位以提高港区防护。: Mikhail Razvozhaev requested strengthening key piers and berths to improve protection of the harbor area.
texts.旗舰莫斯科号已受损并处于离港维护或处置状态，暂不承担前线战备任务。: The flagship Moskva has been damaged and is departing for maintenance or disposal; it is temporarily not assigned to frontline readiness.
texts.海空侦察和电子战在封锁与防护行动中被常态化使用。: Sea and air reconnaissance and electronic warfare are being routinely used in blockade and defensive operations.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫向谢尔盖·阿克西诺夫请求向塞瓦斯托波尔提供防空和电子战支援: Mikhail Razvozhaev requested Sergey Aksyonov to provide air defense and electronic warfare support to Sevastopol.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫向谢尔盖·阿克西诺夫请求向塞瓦斯托波尔紧急补给弹药和燃油。: Mikhail Razvozhaev requested Sergey Aksyonov to urgently resupply Sevastopol with ammunition and fuel.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫向谢尔盖·阿克西诺夫请求对塞瓦斯托波尔的港口与设施进行紧急: Mikhail Razvozhaev requested Sergey Aksyonov to carry out emergency repairs to Sevastopol's port and facilities.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫向谢尔盖·阿克西诺夫请求对塞瓦斯托波尔进行紧急扫雷。: Mikhail Razvozhaev requested Sergey Aksyonov to conduct urgent minesweeping in Sevastopol.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫建议优先保证防空与反舰能力、加强港区被动与主动防护、并提高: Mikhail Razvozhaev recommended prioritizing air defense and anti-ship capabilities, strengthening passive and active port-area protection, and increasing the speed of repairs and ammunition resupply.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫建议俄罗斯黑海舰队优先加强塞瓦斯托波尔的防空与港区防护。: Mikhail Razvozhaev recommended that the Russian Black Sea Fleet prioritize strengthening Sevastopol's air defenses and port-area protection.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫报告称塞瓦斯托波尔已将防空警戒级别提升至高戒备。: Mikhail Razvozhaev reported that Sevastopol had raised its air defense alert level to high readiness.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫报告称塞瓦斯托波尔正在进行救援行动和人员疏散。: Mikhail Razvozhaev reported that Sevastopol was conducting rescue operations and personnel evacuations.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫报告称塞瓦斯托波尔的爆炸和火灾造成人员伤亡。: Mikhail Razvozhaev reported that explosions and fires in Sevastopol had caused casualties.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫报告称塞瓦斯托波尔的码头与燃料及物资仓库遭受中至重度破坏。: Mikhail Razvozhaev reported that Sevastopol's piers and fuel and supply warehouses had sustained moderate to heavy damage.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫指出塞瓦斯托波尔海军基地的后勤与补给承受压力。: Mikhail Razvozhaev noted that logistics and resupply at the Sevastopol naval base were under pressure.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫指出旗舰“莫斯科号”已受损，并正在离开塞瓦斯托波尔港前往维: Mikhail Razvozhaev noted that the flagship Moskva had been damaged and was leaving Sevastopol port for repairs.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫称塞瓦斯托波尔海军基地维持高战备状态。: Mikhail Razvozhaev said the Sevastopol naval base was maintaining a high state of readiness.
texts.米哈伊尔·拉兹沃扎耶夫还建议根据情报动态调整封锁节律以降低暴露点。: Mikhail Razvozhaev also recommended adjusting the blockade tempo based on intelligence dynamics to reduce exposure points.
texts.绍伊古从乌克兰的奥列尼夫卡飞抵克里米亚，目的是协调反制行动。: Sergei Shoigu flew from Olenivka in Ukraine to Crimea to coordinate countermeasures.
texts.绍伊古向普京和格拉西莫夫报告称，格拉西莫夫要求在闭门情况下提交最新情报和地图以供: Shoigu reported to Vladimir Putin and Valery Gerasimov that Gerasimov requested the latest intelligence and maps be submitted in a closed session for briefing.
texts.绍伊古在通报中称，俄罗斯外长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫在安塔利亚的谈判中离场。: Shoigu reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov walked out of the talks in Antalya.
texts.绍伊古在通报中称，安塔利亚举行的黑海粮食外运协议续签谈判已经破裂。: Shoigu reported that negotiations in Antalya to renew the Black Sea grain export agreement had broken down.
texts.绍伊古在通报中称，随后乌克兰南方港口遭到新一轮封锁性炮击。: Shoigu reported that Ukrainian southern ports were subsequently subjected to a new round of blockade-style artillery strikes.
texts.绍伊古在通报后征求总统弗拉基米尔·普京和总参谋长瓦列里·格拉西莫夫的指示。: After the briefing, Shoigu asked President Vladimir Putin and Chief of the General Staff Valery Gerasimov for instructions.
texts.阿克肖诺夫抄送并确认的现场联络人：后勤处长娜塔莉娅·苏霍娃（Sev-Log-1）: Sergey Aksyonov cc'd and confirmed the on-site contact: Logistics Chief Natalia Sukhova (Sev-Log-1).
texts.阿克肖诺夫抄送并确认的现场联络人：扫雷负责人叶夫根尼·彼得罗夫（Sev-MCM）: Sergey Aksyonov cc'd and confirmed the on-site contact: Mine-clearance Lead Yevgeny Petrov (Sev-MCM).
texts.阿克肖诺夫抄送并确认的现场联络人：港务处长安德烈·科罗廖夫（Sev-Port-O: Sergey Aksyonov cc'd and confirmed the on-site contact: Port Operations Director Andrei Korolyov (Sev-Port-Op).
texts.阿克肖诺夫抄送并确认的现场联络人：港务局副局长伊琳娜·马卡洛娃（Sev-Log-: Sergey Aksyonov cc'd and confirmed the on-site contact: Deputy Head of the Port Authority Irina Makalova (Sev-Log-2).
texts.阿克肖诺夫抄送并确认的现场联络人：造船厂主管维克托·列维琴科（Sev-Shipy: Sergey Aksyonov cc'd and confirmed the on-site contact: Shipyard Manager Viktor Levchenko (Sev-Shipyard).
texts.阿克肖诺夫抄送并确认的现场联络人：防空指挥官尤里·斯米尔诺夫（Sev-AAD）。: Sergey Aksyonov cc'd and confirmed the on-site contact: Air Defense Commander Yuri Smirnov (Sev-AAD).
texts.阿克肖诺夫报告塞瓦斯托波尔港当前约有2艘拖轮。: Sergey Aksyonov reported that there were approximately two tugboats currently in Sevastopol port.
texts.阿克肖诺夫报告正在对燃料和仓储设施进行初步检查。: Akshonov reports he is conducting preliminary inspections of fuel and storage facilities.
texts.阿克肖诺夫报告港内浮坞和干坞容量有限。: Akshonov reports the port's floating dock and dry dock capacity is limited.
texts.阿克肖诺夫报告港口弹药与燃油库存承压。: Akshonov reports the port's ammunition and fuel stocks are under pressure.
texts.阿克肖诺夫报告目前尚无确认大规模伤亡，紧急救援与防空力量已提升至高度戒备。: Akshonov reports there are currently no confirmed large-scale casualties; emergency rescue and air defense forces have been raised to high alert.
texts.阿克肖诺夫报告重型吊装能力、舰级检修队伍与关键备件短缺。: Akshonov reports shortages of heavy lifting capability, ship-level maintenance teams, and critical spare parts.
texts.阿克肖诺夫表示详细损毁及火险/泄漏评估将在约4小时内提交。: Akshonov says a detailed damage and fire/leak assessment will be submitted in about four hours.
texts.阿克肖诺夫请求增派扫雷与护航编队并派遣专业修理队伍，以保障码头与航道的短期可用性: Akshonov requests additional mine-clearing and escort task groups and the deployment of specialized repair teams to ensure short-term availability of piers and channels, and requests immediate coordination by the central authorities.
texts.阿克肖诺夫请求立即调配大型干船坞或重型浮船坞及重型拖轮，以组织对“莫斯科号”的转: Akshonov requests the immediate allocation of a large dry dock or a heavy floating dock and heavy tugs to arrange the transfer and docking of Moskva, and requests immediate coordination by the central authorities.
texts.阿克肖诺夫请求紧急增拨防空（远/中/近程）、电子战与反无人机设备，并优先补给弹药: Akshonov urgently requests additional air defenses (long-/medium-/short-range), electronic warfare and counter-UAV equipment, and prioritized resupply of ammunition and fuel, and has requested immediate coordination by the central authorities.
